items: The consultant ____ recommendations were adopted will lead the implementation workshop next week.
The blank shows possession between 'consultant' and 'recommendations', so 'whose' is required.

The blank modifies 'warranty' to show that it belongs to the manufacturer, so 'whose' is required.
